Due to the high number of bug reports coming from installations with multiple active mods, this notice is shown to inform you that BanMod does not guarantee full compatibility with other mods. Before reporting an issue: If you experience errors, crashes, or unexpected behavior, please temporarily remove the other mods and check whether the issue still occurs. Reports sent from clients using additional mods may not be reviewed or may be closed without further action. Harmless mods: If you use simple mods, for example to unlock skins or cosmetic content, you can generally ignore this message. However, avoid enabling any options that modify the chat, as they may cause bugs. Advanced mods or cheat menus: Mods that deeply modify the game, chat, roles, player behavior, or provide unintended advantages may cause serious compatibility issues.
